claim_text: A build receipt means the build has started.
A build receipt does not guarantee the build will succeed.
A build receipt confirms that the scheduler received the build request.
A build receipt includes a request identifier.
The status page shows queued, running, failed, or completed builds.
The export service may send a completion email when an export finishes. Completion emails are optional.
Disabling email does not prevent users from downloading completed exports from the dashboard.
Run logs are deleted after 60 days by default unless an exception policy applies.
Run logs marked for an active audit are retained until the audit owner releases the hold, even if they are older than 60 days.
Verified membership alone is not enough to access the staging workspace.
Human users need both verified membership and two-factor authentication to access the staging workspace.
Service accounts require an active workspace token to access the staging workspace, and the two-factor authentication rule does not apply to them.
For seven batches in one job, the first three batches are free, and the remaining four batches each cost four processing credits.
The total number of processing credits charged for seven batches in one job is sixteen.
The maintenance date for cluster Cedar is 12 November 2028.
Dispatch sheet Alpha establishes a dispatch date of 6 April 2029 for parcel group R6.
Dispatch sheet Beta establishes a dispatch date of 14 April 2029 for parcel group R6.
